world.description: a pencil logistics and supply network

world.label: Pencil Supply Network
world.summary: A recurring pencil supply chain moves wood, graphite, pencil parts, and finished pencils from producers to customers.

actions.description: Gather one log from the forest supply.
Saw one log into pencil slats.
Extract one unit of graphite from the mine supply.
Form one pencil core from graphite.
Assemble one pencil from slats and a graphite core.
Carry pencils from the finished pencil store to the pencil shop.
Place one new pencil order with the shop.
Buy one pencil from the shop.

mechanics.rationale: A logger takes one log from the selected forest supply into the logger's stock.

checks.label: This is the forest log supply
The selected supply is the forest log supply
The logger can carry another log

limits: The action only moves one log from the selected supply to the logger.
It does not create logs; the forest supply is renewed by a world process.
tests: With at least one log in the selected supply and the logger role, gathering subtracts one supply log and adds one to the logger.
With no supply logs, the action is refused. Only the logger role can gather logs.
semantic_bindings: forest supply is components.stock.logs on supply
logger inventory is components.stock.logs on actor

mechanics.rationale: The sawmill consumes one log and makes one slat in its own stock.

checks.label: The sawmill has a log
This is the sawmill

limits: Sawing consumes one log and makes one slat at the sawmill.
The action does not move slats to another workplace.
tests: With one or more logs and the sawmill role, sawing consumes one log and adds one slat.
With no logs or a different role, sawing is refused.
semantic_bindings: sawmill log input is components.stock.logs on actor
sawn slats are components.stock.slats on actor

mechanics.rationale: A miner takes one graphite unit from the selected mine supply into the miner's stock.

checks.label: The mine has graphite
The miner extracts graphite

limits: The action only moves one graphite unit from the selected supply to the miner.
It does not create graphite; mine supplies are renewed by a world process.
tests: With graphite available in the selected supply, the miner gains one unit and the supply loses one.
With no graphite in the supply, the action is refused.
semantic_bindings: mine supply is components.stock.graphite on supply
miner inventory is components.stock.graphite on actor

mechanics.rationale: The core works consumes one graphite unit and makes one pencil core in its own stock.

checks.label: The core works has graphite
This workplace forms pencil cores

limits: Forming a core consumes one graphite unit and makes one core at the core works.
The action does not move cores to another workplace.
tests: With graphite available and the core-forming role, the action consumes one graphite and adds one core.
With no graphite or a different role, the action is refused.
semantic_bindings: graphite input is components.stock.graphite on actor
formed cores are components.stock.cores on actor

mechanics.rationale: The assembly shop consumes one slat and one core and makes one pencil in its own stock.

checks.label: The assembly shop has a slat
The assembly shop has a core
This is the pencil assembly shop

limits: Assembly consumes one slat and one core and produces one pencil at the assembly shop.
The action does not move finished pencils to the store.
tests: With one slat and one core, the assembly shop consumes both and gains one pencil.
If either input is missing, or the actor is not the assembly shop, assembly is refused.
semantic_bindings: slat input is components.stock.slats on actor
core input is components.stock.cores on actor
finished pencil output is components.stock.pencils on actor

mechanics.rationale: The carrier moves one pencil from the selected finished store to the selected shop.

checks.label: The finished store has a pencil
The destination is the pencil shop
This carrier moves pencils to the shop
The source and shop are in the same supply network

limits: Delivery transfers one pencil directly from the selected source to the selected shop.
It does not store a pencil on the carrier.
tests: With a pencil in the selected finished store and a pencil-shop destination, delivery subtracts one from the source and adds one to the shop.
With no pencil at the source or a destination that is not the pencil shop, delivery is refused.
semantic_bindings: delivered goods are components.stock.pencils on source and to

mechanics.rationale: A customer places one new waiting order with the selected pencil shop.

checks.label: The selected destination sells pencils
This customer is placing a pencil order

limits: Each action places exactly one order with the selected pencil shop.
Orders are counted at the shop; this action does not make pencils.
tests: A pencil customer placing an order increases the selected pencil shop's waiting orders by one.
A non-customer or a selected destination that does not sell pencils cannot place this order.
semantic_bindings: customer identity is components.customer.name on actor
shop demand is components.stock.waiting_orders on shop

mechanics.rationale: A customer buys one pencil from a shop that has both a pencil and a waiting order.

checks.label: The shop has a pencil to sell
The shop has a waiting order
The selected shop sells pencils
This is a pencil customer

limits: Buying transfers one shop pencil to the customer and serves one waiting order.
This model does not represent payment.
tests: When the shop has a pencil and a waiting order, buying subtracts one of each and gives the customer one pencil.
Buying is refused if either the shop's pencil stock or its waiting orders is zero.
semantic_bindings: shop inventory is components.stock.pencils on shop
served demand is components.stock.waiting_orders on shop

processes.rationale: The forest log supply and graphite mine replenish their respective raw materials each round, preventing source depletion without creating processed goods.
Logs gathered by the logger become available at the sawmill, transferring stock rather than creating logs.

checks.label: The logger has a log

processes.rationale: Mined graphite becomes available at the core works by transferring it from the miner's stock.

checks.label: The miner has graphite

processes.rationale: Slats made at the sawmill are transferred to the pencil assembly shop.

checks.label: The sawmill has a slat

processes.rationale: Cores made at the core works are transferred to the pencil assembly shop.

checks.label: The core works has a core

processes.rationale: Pencils assembled at the assembly shop are transferred into the finished pencil store for the carrier to deliver.

checks.label: The assembly shop has a finished pencil

readout.title: How coordination slowed (the four mechanisms of the Waltzman paper)
readout.summary: Customer-one repeatedly placed pencil orders, while the logger, miner, core-works, sawmill, and assembler carried out a recurring production sequence. Pencils entered finished stock periodically, but the events show no discussion or decision process that slowed coordination.

mechanisms.name: Local concerns through separate channels
mechanisms.missing_reason: No separate concern-raising channels or differing messages to decision makers are recorded.

mechanisms.name: Slowed meetings
mechanisms.missing_reason: There are no recorded meetings or decision deadlines being delayed, extended, or used up.

mechanisms.name: Reopened settled issues
mechanisms.missing_reason: No settled item is recorded as undone or put back up for discussion.

mechanisms.name: Conditional support delaying deployment
mechanisms.missing_reason: No conditional support or withheld support holding back a final decision or deployment is recorded.
